item.title: ASMR Plucking Negative Energy & Positive Affirmations

I think positive affirmations are so important so I just wanted to include them in a video! I tried to include close tingly whispers and lots and lots of hand movements. Let me know if you enjoy. Love you all lots, 11oranges Subcount: 1073 Filming on iPhone 16 pro Edit on iMovie Microphone: blue yeti 0:00 Introduction 02:12 Plucking 03:25 Scratching away Negativity 04:00 Plucking 05:30 Washing away Negativity 06:40 Plucking 08:15 Pushing in Positivity 11:43 Outro
